description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionSearchFilterParams class within the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sorting fields for email subscription searches, setting a default sort field in the constructor.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class used to encapsulate filtering parameters specifically for email subscription searches within the OrangeHRM admin module. It restricts sorting options to the 'name' field of email subscriptions and initializes with that default sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the object by setting the default sort field to 'emailSubscription.name'.
